clips.title: The story
paras: Young kaldorei gather beneath Aldrassil’s vast boughs in Shadowglen. The settlement shelters trainers, merchants, and local leaders in hollows carved through the great tree.

Aldrassil shelters young night elves in Shadowglen. Ramps wind through its immense trunk, passing trainers and artisans on the way to the high roost. Tenaron Stormgrip watches over the glade’s protection from there. Beyond the tree, Teldrassil stretches across the horizon, while novices learn their arts beneath Aldrassil’s canopy before venturing into Kalimdor’s troubled wilds.
